stem: Which scouting practice best supports trend comparison over time?
choices: Use a consistent route, sampling effort and recording method
Use a different route each round so more areas are visited, while keeping approximately the same total scouting time
Prioritize plants with visible symptoms during each round and compare the number of positive findings from visit to visit
Adjust the number of plants inspected as workload changes, then compare the raw pest counts collected during each scouting round
rationale: Repeatable routes, sampling effort, and recording methods make scouting observations more comparable through time and reduce the chance that a method change is mistaken for a biological trend.
